scope: 限縮輪(只審 round-1 amendment 段落 + cross-round)

findings.problem: 換代 Event + 內容比對短路若未先推進 last → 無 await tight loop 餓死 loop

findings.problem: pending task 收尾未規約,失敗路徑 aclose 會拋 already running
findings.resolution: SC-1 補收尾規約(cancel + suppress;取消後不再迭代)

findings.problem: app.py 若二次呼叫 latest_snapshot 當 seed 會靜默留下 R3 的洞且測試全綠
findings.resolution: SC-3b 明寫同一 dict 物件;新增 test_app 接線測試(monkeypatch 記錄物件同一性)
